description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Vayne''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] a fixed distance in the target direction, though not through terrain, and empowers her next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] within 3 seconds to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]] and deal '''bonus''' physical damage.
description.text: Active: Vayne dashes a fixed distance in the target direction, though not through terrain, and empowers her next basic attack within 3 seconds to have an uncancellable windup and deal bonus physical damage.

description2.raw: ''Tumble [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Vayne's''' basic attack timer.''
description2.text: Tumble resets Vayne's basic attack timer.

leveling.raw:
'''Bonus Physical Damage:'''
75 / 85 / 95 / 105 / 115% AD (+ 50% AP)

notes.raw: * This ability always employs [[Quick cast]]. * The basic attack portion of ''Tumble's'' damage is tagged as [[File:Basic Attack.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Basic damage]] [[:Damage|basic damage]] and [[File:Disintegrate.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Spell damage]] [[:Damage|spell damage]], while the bonus damage is tagged as [[File:Disintegrate.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Spell damage]] [[:Damage|spell damage]]. * The bonus damage applies [[File:Life steal icon.svg|15px|link=Life steal]] life steal. * Although ''Tumble'' will reset the basic attack timer, '''Vayne''' cannot attack until the animation is complete. * '''Vayne''' can cast [[File:Vayne Final Hour.png|20xpx|border|link=Vayne#Final Hour|An icon for Vayne's ability Final Hour]] [[Vayne#Final Hour|Final Hour]] during ''Tumble''. She does not become [[File:Twilight Shroud old2.png|20px|link=Stealth#Invisibility|An icon representing the keyword Invisibility]] [[:Stealth#Invisibility|invisible]] during the dash.
notes.text:
This ability always employs Quick cast.
The basic attack portion of Tumble's damage is tagged as basic damage and spell damage, while the bonus damage is tagged as spell damage.
The bonus damage applies  life steal.
Although Tumble will reset the basic attack timer, Vayne cannot attack until the animation is complete.
Vayne can cast Final Hour during Tumble. She does not become invisible during the dash.
